result.title: PLEDGE: Progressive Lossy Error-Bounded Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) codecs report reconstruction quality after compression, and give users little control over the distortion of individual primitives. We present PLEDGE, a training-free, progressive, error-bounded codec that translates four user-declared tolerances into per-primitive quantization bounds: screen-space position, footprint deformation due to rotation and scale, view-dependent color, and opacity. The bounds apply throughout a declared camera domain, including previously unseen viewpoints. Position and opacity are bounded directly; footprint deformation is bounded under the rasterizer's affine projection model, and color is bounded over all viewing directions. PLEDGE organizes quantized residuals into a progressive bitstream with explicit error bounds for every valid prefix. Experiments across thirteen scenes verify all declared per-mechanism bounds and demonstrate competitive rate-distortion performance. The four tolerances incur substantially different rate costs, so users can spend rate where their application needs it.

AI.brief_summary: PLEDGE 提出一种免训练、渐进式、误差有界的 3D Gaussian Splatting 压缩编解码方法，将用户声明的四类容差（位置、足迹形变、视角相关颜色、不透明度）转化为逐图元的量化界，并组织为带前缀误差保证的渐进比特流。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是 3DGS 几何与颜色表示的压缩率失真与误差界，不涉及 VLM/多模态推理的内部状态、证据使用或停止决策，也未提供可核查的 latent 表示或推理计算线索，故排除。
